title: Evolution of Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) Framework
summary: The AEO concept has evolved from a general collaborative partnership model based on international standards (WCO/WTO) into a structured, tiered regulatory system. It now includes specific procedural requirements for certification, renewal, and tier-based progression, moving from a conceptual framework to a formal legal compliance mechanism.

evolution.regulatory_structure: Shifted from a broad partnership concept to a rigid, rule-based certification and audit regime.
evolution.institutional_oversight: Transitioned from general customs oversight to specialized AEO Centers and Committees.
evolution.compliance_model: Introduced tiered status and mandatory periodic audits as prerequisites for maintaining benefits.

timeline.change: Introduction of System Based Audit (SBA) as a core mechanism for monitoring AEO and other business entities.
Formalization of certification validity, renewal procedures, and tier-based progression (Tier-2 to Tier-3).
Legal definition of AEO and the establishment of the AEO Committee and Center as oversight institutions.

member_objects.resolved_text: ৩.৩ সিস্টেম বেইজড অডিট (SBA)—কোন প্রতিষ্ঠান/ব্যক্তির কাস্টমস সংক্রান্ত কার্যক্রমের পূর্ণাঙ্গ অডিট হলো সিস্টেম বেইজড অডিট পদ্ধতি। এই পদ্ধতিতে অডিটের অধীন প্রতিষ্ঠান/ব্যক্তির ব্যবসা পরিচালনা, কর্মপদ্ধতি, দলিলাদি প্রস্তুতকরণ প্রক্রিয়া, দলিলাদি সংরক্ষণ ও ট্র্যানজ্যাকশন পরীক্ষা করা হয়। অতঃপর প্রাপ্ত ফলাফলের ভিত্তিতে উক্ত প্রতিষ্ঠান/ব্যক্তি কাস্টমস সংশ্লিষ্ট কার্যক্রম কীভাবে পরিচালনা করে সে বিষয়ে নিশ্চিত হওয়া যায়। একইভাবে, AEO (Authorized Economic Operator) প্রতিষ্ঠানের ক্ষেত্রেও SBA প্রয়োগ করা যায়।

System Based Audit: System Based Audit is defined as a comprehensive audit method for evaluating a business or person's customs-related operations.
The audit process involves examining business management practices, operational workflows, documentation preparation, record-keeping, and transaction history.
The results of this audit are used to verify and ensure the legitimacy and compliance of customs-related activities conducted by the entity.
Authorized Economic Operator: System Based Audit procedures may be applied to organizations that have been granted Authorized Economic Operator status.

Customs Audit Process: Following the approval of the preliminary report, the audit team is required to conduct a closing meeting with the audited entity's senior management to present the findings.
The closing meeting serves as a formal platform for the audit team to present their findings and allows the audited entity to provide responses or raise objections to the observations.
Prior to the closing meeting, the audit team must determine the presentation details, and the audit manager must concur with any recommendations regarding underpayments or overpayments.
Customs Audit Procedures: During the closing meeting, the audit team must identify the audited period and specific customs declarations, detail the examination conducted, and discuss the internal control strengths and weaknesses of the business.

The team is required to present recommendations for correcting procedural weaknesses, disclose details of any underpayment or overpayment, and explain the subsequent enforcement actions Customs may take.
The audit team must inform the entity about the right to appeal if they disagree with the audit findings and provide information regarding the possibility of future audits.

member_objects.clause_title: অথরাইজড ইকোনোমিক অপারেটর (AEO) সনদ এর মেয়াদ, নবায়ন ও পরিবর্তন

Authorized Economic Operator: The recognition certificate for an Authorized Economic Operator is valid for a one-year period.

An Authorized Economic Operator must submit an application for renewal within a specified timeframe after the expiration of the certificate, accompanied by updated documents as per the prescribed annexure.

The relevant authority is responsible for verifying the renewal application, conducting post-clearance onsite audits, and renewing the certificate within a set period after receiving the complete application.

Failure to submit a renewal application on time may result in the temporary suspension of Authorized Economic Operator benefits, though benefits may continue if delays are caused by mandatory audit processing timelines or unavoidable administrative reasons.

An Authorized Economic Operator must maintain compliance with established criteria and provide formal notification to the designated center regarding any significant changes to the business, including legal status, management, operational systems, or physical premises.

Any changes to the business or legal status of an Authorized Economic Operator must be reported to the designated center within a specified number of days, and changes in legal entity status require applying for a new recognition certificate.

Authorized Economic Operators are required to proactively disclose any customs-related errors to the authorities; such voluntary disclosures will not adversely impact their status, provided that no serious offences such as tax evasion or smuggling are involved.
Upon identifying customs errors, an Authorized Economic Operator must conduct an internal review to determine the cause and implement preventative measures to ensure the errors do not recur.

অথরাইজড ইকোনমিক অপারেটর (AEO) সেন্টার।

বিষয়: অথরাইজড ইকোনমিক অপারেটর (AEO) এর শ্রেণি-৩ (Tier-3)-এ উন্নীতকরণের জন্য আবেদন।

মহোদয়,

অথরাইজড ইকোনমিক অপারেটর (স্বীকৃতি প্রদান ও পরিচালনা) বিধিমালা, ২০২৪ এর বিধি ৮(১) এর বিধান অনুসারে আমার / আমাদের প্রতিষ্ঠান (প্রতিষ্ঠানের নাম) শ্রেণি-২ (Tier-2) এর অথরাইজড ইকোনমিক অপারেটর (AEO) হিসাবে বিগত --- বৎসর ধরিয়া কার্যক্রম পরিচালনা করিতেছে। শ্রেণি-২ (Tier-2) এর অথরাইজড ইকোনমিক অপারেটর (AEO) হিসাবে আমার/আমাদের প্রতিষ্ঠানের প্রয়োজনীয় নিরীক্ষা সম্পাদিত হইয়াছে এবং উহাতে সন্তোষজনক কার্যক্রম পরিলক্ষিত হইয়াছে (কপি সংযুক্ত)।

আপনার বিশ্বস্ত,

Authorized Economic Operator: This form serves as the official application for a business to be upgraded to Tier-3 status within the Authorized Economic Operator program.

Applicants must demonstrate a history of successful operations under Tier-2 status and provide documentation confirming that their business has passed the required audits as stipulated by the governing rules.
Authorized Economic Operator (Recognitio: This procedural regulation sets the legal framework and specific rules governing the application, auditing, and recognition process for businesses seeking Tier-3 Authorized Economic Operator status.
Business Identification Number: Applicants are required to provide their Business Identification Number as part of the formal data submission for the Tier-3 recognition process.

Authorized Economic Operator: An Authorized Economic Operator is defined as a business entity that has been granted recognition and certification under the relevant rule of these regulations.
The Center acts as the primary oversight organization, although other customs offices may act as supervising bodies within their respective legal jurisdictions for certified entities.
Customs Act 2023: This regulation formally defines the Act as the Customs Act of 2023.
Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) Commi: The Committee is defined as the specific body responsible for the oversight and administration of authorized economic operator matters as specified in the rules.
Customs Authority: The term Customs Official refers to any officer appointed under the provisions of Section 4 of the Customs Act.
National Board of Revenue: The Board refers to the national body established under the Presidential Order of 1972.
Logistics Operator: A Logistics Operator is defined as a service provider involved in customs-related processes, including customs agents, shipping agents, freight forwarders, terminal operators, and courier services.
Affiliated Institution: An affiliate is defined through specific ownership or management links, covering entities controlled by the same owner, partner, director, or chairman across various forms of business ownership.
Provisional Certificate: A provisional certificate is a time-bound authorization granted by the committee to a business, subject to the fulfillment of specific conditions.
Recognition Certificate: The recognition certificate refers to the official document issued to an entity upon fulfilling the regulatory requirements established for authorized operators.
